name: Honey, raw
source: Proximate (per kg) water 171 g (~17%), sugars 826 g, protein/enzyme content ~1 g, ash 2 g (USDA FoodData Central pattern for raw honey).
notes: Honey's sugar is predominantly invert sugar (glucose and fructose from nectar sucrose, inverted by the bees' own invertase), so it is modelled with the glucose/fructose (C6H12O6) elemental ratio rather than sucrose's — a real, documented distinction from forage-nectar's own sucrose-ratio sugar.
